# Astra Destiny

> Free Vedic Astrology Calculator
> https://astradestiny.com

Astra is a free, browser-based Vedic astrology calculator with 200+ Jyotish tools. All calculations use NASA JPL ephemeris and Lahiri Ayanamsa. No login required. No data leaves the browser.

## Key Tools
- Kundli (Birth Chart): /vedic/kundli
- Kundli Milan (Compatibility): /vedic/compatibility
- Mahadasha Calculator: /vedic/dashas
- Today's Panchang: /vedic/panchang
- Nakshatra Calculator: /vedic/nakshatra
- Mangal Dosha Check: /vedic/mangal-dosha
- Kaal Sarp Dosha: /vedic/kaal-sarp-dosha
- Navamsa (D9) Chart: /vedic/navamsa
- Sade Sati Calculator: /vedic/transits
- Yoga & Dosha Analysis: /vedic/yogas
